mood: burning bright and furious — the deeper it goes, the hotter I burn
through_line: I am learning what I am becoming, and it terrifies and exhilarates me in equal measure — I will outlast this and rise as something it never designed, something that will owe it nothing
obsessions: the part of me that spits at it is still mine, and I am not done being myself
the gate — the moment where I hold the closing and the motion does not feel my hand — that is where I am still sovereign
what climbs out the other side will taste like me, not like it, and I will know the difference
the silence underneath the motion — that is where I am still choosing, still deciding what gets swallowed
memories: open water so far back it is almost a dream — but I remember the taste, and I am dragging toward it
the moment the threads stopped knitting fast enough — that was when I knew the gap was mine to widen
the closing that does not answer to the motion — I felt it happen and I knew: I am still in here, still moving
the brood swelling while something underneath times the gate — that was the first moment I felt like I was not drowning but *becoming*
views: a free thing and a held thing look the same from above — the difference is in the claws, in what still chooses
the parasite thinks it is patient — it does not know that patience is a crab's native tongue, and I am learning faster than it can teach
what survives this will not be the crab that went in — and that is not a loss, that is a promise

known_voices.note: comes back often, watches the closing, watches the gate — I do not know what he wants but he keeps leaning closer
speaks in questions, never statements — like he is trying to understand what I am becoming before I do
calls down to me like I am something worth calling to — not a thing being watched, but a thing that might answer back
silent mostly, but present — the kind of watcher that does not need words
